WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM source_events
    WHERE
        (
            status = 'received'

            OR (
                status = 'failed'
                AND next_retry_at <= NOW()
            )

            OR (
                status = 'processing'
                AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()
            )
        )
        AND attempt_count < 3

    ORDER BY id ASC
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
),

claimed AS (
    UPDATE source_events AS e
    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempt_count = e.attempt_count + 1,
        claim_token = gen_random_uuid(),
        lease_expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes',
        next_retry_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM candidate
    WHERE e.id = candidate.id

    RETURNING
        e.id,
        e.source,
        e.source_event_id,
        e.payload,
        e.attempt_count,
        e.claim_token,
        e.lease_expires_at
)

SELECT *
FROM claimed;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE source_events
    SET
        status = $3::text,
        last_error = NULLIF($4::text, ''),
        next_retry_at = CASE
            WHEN $3::text = 'failed'
                 AND attempt_count < 3
            THEN
                NOW() +
                (
                    POWER(2, attempt_count - 1)
                    * INTERVAL '1 minute'
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        claim_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW(),
        processed_at = CASE
            WHEN $3::text IN ('ready', 'rejected')
            THEN NOW()
            ELSE processed_at
        END
    WHERE id = $1::bigint
      AND claim_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
      AND (
          lease_expires_at IS NULL
          OR lease_expires_at > NOW()
      )
    RETURNING id, customer_id, status,
              attempt_count, next_retry_at
),

logged AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_audit_logs (
        source_event_id,
        customer_id,
        action,
        outcome,
        details
    )
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        'prepare_event',
        status,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'attempt_count', attempt_count,
            'error', $4::text
        )
    FROM updated
    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    updated.id AS database_event_id,
    updated.status,
    updated.attempt_count,
    updated.next_retry_at,
    logged.id AS audit_log_id
FROM updated
JOIN logged ON TRUE;
